title: VPN Connection Troubleshooting
content: If a user cannot connect to the corporate VPN, verify network connectivity, confirm the VPN client configuration, clear cached credentials, and authenticate again.

title: Password Reset Procedure
content: For a forgotten corporate password, verify the user's identity, reset the password through the approved identity-management workflow, and require the user to create a new password.

title: Account Lockout Procedure
content: When an account is locked after repeated authentication failures, verify the user identity and unlock the account through the approved identity-management system.

title: Outlook Troubleshooting
content: If Outlook crashes during startup, restart the workstation, disable problematic add-ins, repair the Office installation, and verify the mailbox connection.

title: Laptop Overheating
content: For an overheating laptop, inspect ventilation, remove dust from cooling components, check CPU utilization, and escalate hardware faults when required.

title: Printer Connectivity
content: For an unavailable network printer, verify network connectivity, confirm the printer IP address, reinstall the printer connection if necessary, and test printing.

title: Blue Screen Troubleshooting
content: For repeated blue-screen crashes, collect the crash code and system logs, identify recently changed drivers or software, and escalate persistent hardware or driver failures.

title: Email Delivery Troubleshooting
content: For external email delivery failures, verify mailbox configuration, inspect mail gateway status, check delivery restrictions, and review relevant mail logs.
